Subject: Implementation of CCPAP for cheques drawn on A/C no. 2 w.e.f. March 10, 2016.
Reference: Circulars at Serial numbers 434 and 698 on EPFO website undet circular section for
the year 2015-16.

Madam/Sir,
As we all are aware, to improve safety, cheques drawn on A/C no. 1, 10, and 21 are migrated to
a payment platform known as Corporate Cheque Drawn at Par (CCPAP). Now this system is to
be extended to cover cheques drawn on A/C no. 2 and the date for its implementation, as
communicated earlier, is March 10, 2016. Items of preparatory work, which were supposed to
be complete at the level of RO/SRO concerned, for this rollout are listed below:
1. Each office must get existing/old A/C 2 closed and should get a new bank account
(current account) for A/C 2 opened under CCPAP category.
2. All old A/C 2 cheques (Instrument type 11) must be disposed of as per extant
instructions.
3. New instrument (cheque books) namely, “Multicity (Payable at par) CT'S-2010 Standard
Cheques” (MCC), (Instrument type 29) must be secured from the relevant bank branch
(all Core Banking branches are authorized to issue MCCs).
4. Digital signatures to be secured for DDO alongwith two link officers alongwith
completion of related paraphernalia.
5. WAR software supplement released recently by the Project Division for this purpose has
to be installed and integrated with the present system software.

Regarding timeline, new CCPAP-enabled current account A/C 2 was to be opened and MCC
cheques secured against newly opened account on or before December 10, 2015 i.e. a minimum
of three months prior to the proposed rollout date. Completion of the listed actions three
months in advance is necessitated to ensure that no old A/C 2 cheque drawn on earlier saving
A/C 2 which are within their validity period (within 3 months from the date of issue) and yet to
be encashed are dishonoured on account of closure of the old saving A/C no. 2.

Accordingly, all officers are required to ensure that starting March 10, 2016, all cheques
drawn on A/C 2 are issued through CCPAP platform.

This issues with the approval of Regional Commissioner-I (F&A).

Yours faithfully
